title: Flow Language Vertical Slice
description: End-to-end vertical slice for flow procedural language: neural engine (Dictionary/Neuron/Evaluator), math module, DAG UI crate, flow core wasm, react renderer, and play app with slider->add->preview default fixture.
summary:
Fixed `bun run dev:flow` failing when port 6016 is occupied: `runViteBunxDev` now scans for the next free port (6017, 6018, …) instead of exiting. Added `bun ./script.ts validate` / `@flow/play:validate` playwright probe that finds the live flow dev server, confirms no Unsupported UiNode, initial preview 3, slider change to 5 updates preview, and [DEBUG] evaluate logs.

End-to-end validation passed on http://127.0.0.1:6016/ with debug logs for preview 3 and 5.
